browserBatches.name: maps, combat, portraits, pilots, languages and unit management
weak connections, automatic resume and two-client full battle
research, parallel combat, sorting and editable squad plans
V80 final portrait, sorting and reconnect smoke checks

limitations: No complete comparison against the V79 full-suite failure baseline was performed. Do not classify every failure as pre-existing or harmless.
Weak-network tests inject lost or delayed application responses, send failures, congestion and reconnection on local sockets; they do not measure packet loss on a public WAN.
Performance measurements cover scripted workloads on this machine, not all mobile GPUs.
